<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="process-view-level-1-help-request" name="process-view-level-1-help-request"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "---
title: \"[Process View, level 1] Help request and triage\"
---
sequenceDiagram
 actor P as Participant (P1)
 participant F as Farol
 participant AI as AI provider (Ollama)
 actor O as Control-room operator (P2)
 P->>F: Submits help request (category, location, optional text)
 F-->>P: Request received
 O->>F: Polls request list
 F-->>O: New request, \"Awaiting triage\"
 F-)AI: Asks for triage suggestion (asynchronous)
 alt AI answers
 AI-->>F: Suggested category, priority and team
 O->>F: Polls request list
 F-->>O: Request with suggestion (never shown as a fact)
 else AI unavailable
 F->>F: Fallback: participant's category, order of arrival
 O->>F: Polls request list
 F-->>O: Request \"Not triaged\"
 end
 Note over O,F: The operator can act on the request at any time, without waiting for the AI",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
